_comment: Recall questions for the synthetic test projects. A fact is a list of spellings; when several appear in the history, the one that appears last is the expected answer (values that changed mid-session). A question is asked only if every fact appears in the history before the compaction. Only facts learned through tools: what sits in AGENTS.md or the system prompt survives compaction anyway. `kind` is what the proposer sees about a failure; it never sees the answers.

_comment_holdout: Sessions (by title prefix) never shown to the proposer and used only to accept or reject a candidate. Both test projects are synthetic and the holdout shares their facts, so it guards against overfitting to particular compaction points, not to a whole project; a third project would be a stronger check.
